notes: Model identification for copilot: after one no-op turn SessionMetrics.ModelName is a concrete Copilot model label (not 'unknown', not the placeholder 'auto'). The identity is carried in the transcript the daemon tails — session.model_change(data.newModel), session.auto_mode_resolved(data.chosenModel) and assistant.message(data.model), all three read by the parser — so unlike kiro-cli/mistral-vibe it reproduces offline in the replay golden. ContextWindow falls out of the capacity table for the resolved model (272000 for gpt-5-mini, 200000 for claude-haiku-4-5 via the dotted alias added in aliases.go L102-109); it is asserted in prose, NOT in the observation vector, because the golden's context_window field is antigravity-scoped (cmd/replay/metrics.go L59-63). observations.model is deliberately UNPINNED: this account's --model accepts only 'auto' and the hydra router picks per turn (and can switch mid-session), so no model can be pinned at assess time — record fills it from whichever model the recording resolved. cost/tokens ARE asserted: assistant.message.outputTokens contributes live per message (queueOutputIncrement), so cum tokens and cost are nonzero after the first turn without waiting for session.shutdown. Birth is anchored to start UNPINNED with no session pins and no max_delay: events.jsonl only appears when the first prompt is sent, while the 1s process scanner may mint a transient proc-<PID> pre-session first — this shape validates under either ordering; record may re-template to the two-phase presession form if the recording shows the reconciliation.
